    Starters3am toasted cheese sandwichesCheddar and Dijon sandwiches toasted golden in a panHow to make it8 slices of white bread40g butter, softened200g cheddar, grated2 tsp Dijon mustardButter the outsides of the bread.Fill the sandwiches with cheddar and a thin spread of Dijon.Toast in a pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side.Cut into strips.Ouija board crackersCrisp lavash stenciled with smoked paprika letters, whipped feta and yoghurt dipHow to make it2 lavash breads2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil1 tbsp smoked paprika150g feta100g Greek yoghurtBrush the lavash with oil.Stencil letters and numbers on with smoked paprika.Bake at 180°C until crisp.Whip the feta with the yoghurt to dip. Don't ask it anything.Powdered-floor parmesan garlic flatbreadsThe baby powder footprints that lead to the attic hatchHow to make itAs written, serves 4Soft yoghurt flatbreads charred in a hot pan, brushed with garlic butter and dusted thick with finely grated parmesan, with a smoky tomato dip.Mix 300g self-raising flour, 300g Greek yoghurt and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and knead 2 minutes.Divide into 8, roll thin and cook in a dry hot pan for 1 to 2 minutes a side until blistered.Melt 60g butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves and parsley, brush over and dust with 50g finely grated parmesan.Blend 200g roasted tomatoes with 1 tsp smoked paprika, olive oil and salt for the dip.MainsLate night takeaway pizzaThin crust pizza with mozzarella, pepperoni and mushroomsHow to make it500g pizza dough200g crushed tomatoes250g mozzarella100g pepperoni150g mushrooms, slicedStretch the dough into two thin bases.Spread with tomatoes and top with mozzarella, pepperoni and mushrooms.Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes. Rewatch the tape.San Diego battered fish tacosThe couple's house in San DiegoHow to make itAs written, serves 4Crisp battered white fish in warm corn tortillas with lime slaw, pickled onion and a chipotle crema, plenty of coriander and lime wedges.Quick-pickle 1 sliced red onion in 100ml vinegar with 1 tsp sugar and salt.Shred a quarter red cabbage and toss with lime juice and salt.Mix 150ml sour cream with 1 chopped chipotle in adobo.Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 200ml cold sparkling water into a batter.Cut 600g flathead or ling into strips, dip and fry at 180°C for 3 minutes.Warm 12 corn tortillas and fill with fish, slaw, onion, crema and coriander.Sweets3am chocolate potsBaked dark chocolate custard in small cupsHow to make it300ml thickened cream200ml milk150g dark chocolate, chopped4 egg yolks60g caster sugarWarm the cream and milk, pour over the chocolate and stir smooth.Whisk the yolks with the sugar and combine.Pour into small cups and bake in a water bath at 150°C for 30 minutes.Chill until set.DrinksNight-watch espresso martinisEspresso, vodka and coffee liqueur shaken ice coldHow to make it4 shots of espresso coffee160ml vodka80ml coffee liqueur20ml sugar syrup6 coffee beans2 cups iceMake the espresso and cool for 5 minutes.For each drink, measure 1 shot espresso coffee, 40ml vodka, 20ml coffee liqueur and 5ml sugar syrup into a shaker.Shake half the batch at a time with plenty of ice for 20 seconds until frothy.Strain into chilled coupes and repeat.
